Preserve the lower crossover and BOTH bottom ends, the additional mid-left branch, upper crossbar's short left overhang, and bowed upper-right arm. Total FIVE long bottom ends across glyph: three on left, two on right; plus the right figure's separate midheight branch ends. Do not omit the mid-left branch or merge away the diagonal's upper-right endpoint.
